blocks.text: WASHINGTON D.C., United States—The United States on Friday lifted an hours-long ground stop at the nation’s airports. Top officials explaining that the disruption was due to old equipment and not a cyberattack or sweeping Microsoft outage. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy told a late-night briefing at the White House that US airspace was now “opened up,” while warning it would take time for the travel chaos to clear. “At 8:15 tonight Eastern Time, we’ve opened up the airspace,” Duffy said. “Now, does that mean every flight is going to fly right now? It’s going to be slow.” The breakdown came a day after […]... Keep on reading: US airspace has now 'opened up,' says transportation secretary
